purpose: analysis-only metadata/support sensitivity based on optional Overture attributes; no labels, target fit, accuracy claim, promotion, or upload

source_docs.schema_documentation_version_observed: v2.0.0; challenge parquet top-level schemas are inventoried in docs/data-inventory.md

scope.baseline_candidate: C2 component estimator v0, official-region rows only

baseline.role: measure-before and candidate baseline only; model estimates are not labels or sample placeholders

feature_inventory.role: frozen challenge package schema inventory; schema verification uses public package Parquet footers

provided_tract_assignment.role: provided polygon index only; no housing-unit values

status_definition.missing: Parquet value is null; if an optional column is absent from the file schema, mark schema_unavailable instead and exclude that field from support denominators.
status_definition.present_empty: Non-null scalar text is empty, list/map is empty, or nested struct has no nonempty child value.
status_definition.present_explicit_unknown: Exact case-insensitive scalar string token unknown or unspecified in the field_registry unknown_token_fields; it remains a present nonempty field and is never reclassified as missing.
status_definition.present_mixed_unknown_known: For a supported nested struct, at least one exact unknown token and at least one known nonempty scalar child occur.
status_definition.present_known: Nonempty value not classified as an explicit unknown token.
status_definition.support_indicator: 1 for present_known, present_explicit_unknown, or present_mixed_unknown_known; 0 for missing or present_empty. Unknown remains distinct in the audit and is not treated as absence.
status_definition.unknown_detection_scope: Unknown-token scanning is exact and case-insensitive for scalar categorical fields named in unknown_token_fields. Nested list payloads are measured for null/empty/nonempty presence but not recursively interpreted as unknown labels.

spatial_assignment.tract_assignment: provided ACS tract geometry; use same deterministic point-in-polygon helper and boundary tie rule as the competition POI audit
spatial_assignment.unassigned: outside/invalid bbox centers are excluded from tract-level candidate support and counted; no geometry fallback or external layer

candidate_formula.theme_support: Within each official tract and theme, sum nonempty support indicators over assigned source features and selected schema-available fields, divided by assigned feature_count times available_field_count. A theme with no assigned feature rows has unavailable support and is excluded from the cross-theme mean.
candidate_formula.tract_support: Equal mean of available POI, building, and road theme_support values; if none is available, support is unavailable and candidate adjustment is neutral zero.
candidate_formula.regional_reference: Median tract_support among official tracts with available support within the same region; recomputed after each declared optional-field drop perturbation.
candidate_formula.deficit: If support is available, clip((regional_reference - tract_support)/max(regional_reference, 1e-12), 0, 1); otherwise zero.
candidate_formula.adjustment: 0.05 * deficit, positive context sensitivity fixed before measurement.
candidate_formula.candidate_score: clip(C2 coverage_gap_score + adjustment, 0, 1) for every official GEOID.
candidate_formula.interpretation: Internal attribute richness is a metadata/support hypothesis only; it is not evidence of real-world feature completeness or a hidden target.

measurement_plan.measure_before: Report frozen C2 score moments overall and by region; report that no cross-theme field-level presence matrix is in the prior reports.
measurement_plan.measure_after: Report all declared optional field status counts and coverage by theme/region (source total and official-tract assigned rows), schema availability, missing versus empty versus explicit unknown, bbox assignment edge cases, per-tract support, candidate adjustment distribution, exact IDs/bounds, and hashes.
measurement_plan.optional_field_perturbation: For every theme.field, drop only that attribute from support computation, renormalize on the remaining schema-available fields, rederive region medians/scores, and assert max absolute candidate score change <=0.05. Also report the simultaneous all-optional-fields-unavailable neutral fallback.
measurement_plan.determinism: Run complete builder twice and compare candidate CSV, manifest, and report byte-for-byte.

limitations: Feature bbox centers are an inexpensive tract-assignment proxy and can differ from a geometry-intersection assignment, particularly for long roads or large buildings.
Optional-attribute presence may reflect source conventions, feature type, or provider workflows rather than positional, semantic, or geographic completeness.
The v2 candidate is a fixed bounded sensitivity against C2 and has no target validation or authorization for scored integration.
